terra.problem: The line says Israel “never” drove out the Geshurites, but Joshua 13:13 says they remained among Israel “to this day.” Say Israel “did not drive them out.”

“A king’s daughter marries David” describes Absalom’s birth in Hebron, not an event in Geshur. The passage also does not describe the marriage itself. Replace this moment with one that takes place in Geshur.
“Joab brings Absalom home” says Joab perceived that David longed for Absalom, but that detail appears in 2 Samuel 14:1, outside the cited passage. Expand the passage or omit the detail.

“Absalom’s vow made in Geshur” describes Absalom telling David about the vow and asking to go to Hebron, not the vow being made in Geshur. Reframe it around the vow Absalom said he made while living there.
